Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game then! Another game follows and that is a clash between Zimbabwe and Ireland! Stay tuned for that one as it will begin shortly. Until next time, take care and goodbye!

Richie Berrington says it was hard work and it is a special win for them. Adds they wanted a few more runs but they knew they had a competitive score on the board. Credits the way the bowlers bowled and he is very pleased.

Nicholas Pooran says it is a tough loss for them. Reckons, 160 was a par score but the middle order was quite poor. Admits they need to play better in the coming games which are must-win. States they are looking forward for the next games.

George Munsey. MAN OF THE MATCH SAYS, the injury is not that okay and they will see what they have to do in the coming days. Adds they gave it their all in the field and Mark Watt was brilliant. Reckons it got trickier to bat as the ball went old but he enjoyed it at the start.
... TIME FOR THE PRESENTATION ...

Earlier in the day, after being inserted, Scotland posted a decent total of 160 thanks to a really good effort by Munsey. However, that score seemed under par at first but a brilliant effort by the ball and some poor batting meant, it was Scotland who finished on top.

West Indies will be very disappointed with their performace! They were extremely poor with the bat. They were off to a good start but post the 6th over, they lost wickets in heaps. After the top three, just the one batter crossed the 10-run mark and that was Holder. The game just came all down to his performance but it was too much of an ask from him. In the end, they have fallen short by a big margin.

YET ANOTHER UPSET! Windies have been beaten by Scotland and quite convincingly. A brilliant performance with the ball by them. They began brilliantly as they got a wicket early in the Powerplay but it was the overs after the Powerplay that was good. The likes of Watt and Michael Leask really made run-scoring tough and both got crucial wickets. They finished with 5 between them and and only gave away 26 in the 8 overs bowled by them. Those 8 overs really turned the game completely in the favor of Scotland and the pacers backed up the good job and ensured their side came out on top.

OUT! TAKEN! There it is! There is the final wicket and that is the win for Scotland! A remarkable performance by them! A full one on off, Holder looks to go downtown but does not hit it that well. It is taken by the fielder at long off, Chris Greaves! SCOTLAND WIN BY 42 RUNS!
Commentary.Howout: c Chris Greaves b Safyaan Sharif

Commentary.Commentary: Obed McCoy gets Holder back on strike! Outside off, he swings, it goes off the outside edge down to third man for one.
On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Two! Another full toss, this is hit wide of deep cover for two.
FOUR! Carved away again! Back-to-back boundaries! A full toss outside off, Holder places it wide of point and this one races away to the fence behind.
FOUR! Fuller and on middle, this is hit between long on and mid-wicket for a boundary.
Two dots in a row! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket. No run taken.
That is very nicely bowled! A slower one angled into the pads. Holder swings but misses to get hit on the pads.
He blocks it out! On middle, this is pushed back to the bowler. 56 needed in 18.
Just the one! Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one. What will Obed McCoy do now?
WIDE! Well wide outside off, left alone.
Fuller and on off, Holder hits it back to the bowler.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.

OUT! TAKEN! The big hitting Odean Smith has to walk back! It is all slipping away way too quickly for the Windies. He steps out and makes room. Watt slows it up and lands it outside off. It is hit uppishly but towards long off where Chris Greaves takes an easy catch. Holder now probably has to do it all by himself. Would be a miracle.
Commentary.Howout: c Chris Greaves b Mark Watt

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller and outside off, bowling to his field, just the one as this is hit towards sweeper cover.
Holder could have hit that a long way! He probably wanted strike! On middle, a full toss, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Carved away! 100 up. 11 from the over with a ball to go. 61 more needed. Outside off and fuller, this is carved past the point fielder and it goes into the fence.
Short and down the leg side, Holder looks to pull but misses. Dots are gold.

SIX! Sails into the crowd! You can score heavily in the last few overs here. The boundary s short on that side. On middle, Holder heaves it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. Windies need a few more of these.
Just the one! Singles won't harm Scotland! Outside off, shorter, this is cut through point for one.
Swing and a miss! Length and outside off, Smith looks to go big down the ground but misses.
On middle, nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
Bangs a short ball, outside off. Smith leaves it alone.
Length and on middle. Holder punches it to long off for one more.
On middle, clipped to deep mid-wicket for a single.
This is full and on middle. Holder makes room and drives to deep cover. One more.
Fuller and outside off. Smith knocks it to cover for a single.
Outside off, Holder cuts it to short third man.
On off, kept out.
Mark Watt gives a warning to Odean Smith as he was backing way too much on the non-striker's end.
FOUR! Edgy! Outside off, flat. Holder looks to cut but gets an outside edge to third man for four.
Nearly through! This one comes with the angle, slides on around off. Holder somehow keeps it out.
Tossed up, outside off, Smith drives it through covers for one.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! West Indies are falling like pins! Flatter ball, outside off, skidding through. Joseph goes way back in his crease to cut but gets a faint edge and the keeper pouches it cleanly. Matthew Cross makes no mistake. Scotland 2 wickets away now.
Commentary.Howout: c Matthew Cross b Mark Watt

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter, quicker and outside off. Holder makes room to cut but misses.
Around off, dropped to cover.

OUT! RUN OUT! Flatter and outside off. Holder pushes it softly to point. There was no run any day but Hosein was running across without thinking much. The keeper runs across, picks up and throws it to the bowler. Leask misses in his attempt but Hosein was so back that Leask clips the bails off easily on his second attempt. West Indies are making things difficult for themselves.
Very full and on the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Length and outside off. Holder knocks it to covers for a single.
Outside off, length and Holder fails to get his bat on it.

OUT! TAKEN!  Brooks goes now! What are West Indies doing here? Short of a length and outside off. Brooks pull, it goes more off the upper half of the bat and towards deep mid-wicket. Michael Leask runs in, dives and takes a brilliant catch. It was dying but Leask kept his hand underneath.
Commentary.Howout: c Michael Leask b Brad Wheal

Commentary.Commentary: Much tight! On off, played back to the bowler.
Uses the pace! Outside off, Holder steers it to third man for one.
Another single as this time Brooks plays it to third man.
Length and outside off. Holder works it to third man for a single.
On a length and around off, Holder flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
Outside off, guided to point.
This is full and angled from 'round the wicket, outside off. Holder fails to drive it away.
Flatter ball, outside off, Brooks tucks it to deep mid-wicket for one more.
On middle, this is hit to mid-wicket for a single.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust! Scotland making inroads here. This is full and in the slot for Rovman Powell to go big but he ends up only getting more height than distance. The ball goes high and Calum MacLeod at long on takes a simple catch to his right.
Commentary.Howout: c Calum MacLeod b Michael Leask

Commentary.Commentary: Two dots now! Short in length and outside off. Brooks taps it to cover. West Indies need 92 runs in 60 balls.
Length and outside off, cut straight to point.
Outside off, guided to third man for a single.
A single as this is hit to long on.
This is full and way outside off, driven to covers for a single.
Almost chopped on! Length and on off. Powell defends very late and inside edges it past the leg stump.
On middle, tucked to mid-wicket for one.
This is full and outside off. Powell looks to go big but slices and the ball falls in the vacant deep cover region. Two runs.
Wide! Way outside off. Powell looks to pull but misses.

OUT! BOWLED! Leask strikes now and West Indies are not able to play the spinners at all. Leask angles a flatter ball, around off and this one skids on as well. Pooran hangs on the back foot to pull but misses and the stumps are disturbed. Scotland are well and truly on top.
Full and outside off, driven to deep cover for a single.
This is full and on middle. Pooran skips down and works it to mid-wicket for a single.

This is short and outside off. Pooran looks to cut but gets a bottom edge and the ball hits the keeper's pads before rolling onto the stumps. An appeal for stumping but the replay shows Pooran was inside his crease all the time.
On middle, this is hit to mid-wicket for a single.
Leg bye! Down the leg side, Brooks misses his flick and it rolls off the pads and goes to fine leg.

OUT! TIMBER! King goes and West Indies are in real trouble. Flatter and on top of off, this one skids on and comes with the angle. King makes room as he looks to cut but misses and the off pole is disturbed. Mark Watt removed a paper, looked like there was some tactics written on it against King.
On middle, blocked out.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
Touch short and on middle. Pooran looks to pull but gets pinned on the pads. An appeal but that was high.
On the pads, King sweeps but finds the man at short fine leg.
Another run as this is eased down to long on again.
Flatter and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
A very full ball on off, almost a yorker, it is jammed out to covers.
On middle, this is nudged through mid-wicket and a run is taken.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.

A dot to end! A good 6th from Wheal. The game is nicely poised after the first 6. Maybe more towards the Windies keeping their long batting line-up in mind. They are 53 for 2 after it. The last ball is full and on off, it is hit to cover.

OUT! TAKEN! The dangerous Lewis falls and just as the game was slipping away, Scotland strike! 108 more needed in 85. This is short and on the body, Lewis looks to pull, it goes off the splice towards deep square leg. The fielder there, Michael Jones makes no mistake.
Commentary.Howout: c Michael Jones b Brad Wheal

Commentary.Commentary: Angled into the pads, King works it towards mid-wicket and takes one.

FOUR! That is caressed! Not a lot wrong with the delivery but it is hit wonderfully. Length and on off, King strokes it on the up, there are two fielders in the cover region but he beats both and the ball races away to the fence.
Good length and on middle, defended.
On middle, Lewis works it on the leg side and gets to the other end.
FOUR! That is glorious! Wow! What a shot! Fuller and on off, King shows the full face of the bat and lifts it towards the long off fence for a boundary.
WIDE! Another extra! Shorter and down the leg side. King leaves it alone.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed wide of mid off for one.
A yorker on the pads, Lewis works it to mid-wicket.
SIX! Over the fence! Evin Lewis steps out, he gets to the pitch of it and hits it over the long off fence for a biggie.
ON middle, kept out.
On middle, this is tucked around the corner for one.
A dot to end a long and an expensive over! On the pads, this is worked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! This time it is tickled away to the fence! On the pads, Lewis works it fine and this one races away to the fence.
WIDE! Another wide! Down the leg side. Lewis looks to pull but misses. Not sure if that is the line one would want to bowl to Lewis.
Two taken! On the pads, this is worked behind square on the leg side for two.
Outstanding stop! Fuller and on off, King drives it hard towards cover. The fielder dives to his right and gets a hand to it. Saves at least two for his side.
FOUR! Hammered! Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for a boundary.
On the pads, Lewis looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Safyaan Sharif gets away with one there! Shorter and down the leg side. Lewis looks to pull but misses.
Another dot to end! On off, blocked.
Solid from King! Length and on off, he defends it nicely.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a superb catch! George Munsey did it with the bat earlier on and now in the field. Just can't keep him out of the game and Mayers who was getting into his element, falls. This is full and on middle, Mayers looks to flick it uppishly but is through the shot early. It may have been a slower one. It goes high up in the air towards mid-wicket. George Munsey runs back and takes a good catch with a slide. He had to be aware about the deep square leg fielder coming in too. Really good.
Commentary.Howout: c George Munsey b Josh Davey

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Over the fence. That is easy pickings for Mayers! On the pads, he whips it over square leg for a biggie. Dealing in boundaries now is Mayers.

FOUR! Up and over! Really classy shot! Fuller and on middle, Mayers lifts it over the bowler's head towards long off. It lands and slows down. Long on runs to his right and dives but can't stop it. Runs flowing now.
On the shorter side, Mayers looks to pull, this goes off the pad and towards short fine leg.
Good length and on off, Lewis defends it back to the bowler.
Angled into the pads, Mayers works it through square leg and takes one.

FOUR! Nicely guided! Shorter and outside off, Mayers guides it past point and this one races away to the fence. Two boundaries in a row. Not the kind of over Scotland would have wanted after a tidy first one.
FOUR! This one is hammered! Slightly shorter and on middle, Mayers pulls it hard and through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Hit firmly but for no runs! Fuller and on off, Mayers drives but to covers.
Shorter and on off, Mayers pushes it to mid off.
A dot to end a top first over by Watt! Shorter and on off, this is pushed towards cover.
Was that a chance? Maybe! Down the leg side. Evin Lewis looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and goes to the keeper who fails to take it cleanly.
And again, gets it to tail back in from outside off, it is fuller, Mayers hits it down to long on for one.
On the stumps, flatter. Defended again. Good start by Watt.
Gets that to swing back in! It starts outside off and comes back in. Mayers looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal but turned down. Going down leg.
A very full delivery to begin with! On off, it is jammed back to the bowler.
